questions.label: Why should GWR Leadership trust you to lead one of its guilds?

agreement: This is the first pilot of a new GWR-operated guild model.
The guild is a permanent part of the Guild Wars Revival network.
The Guild Leader receives significant operational freedom.
The Guild Leader position is a leadership mandate and does not constitute personal ownership of the guild.
GWR-wide activities and events are part of the responsibility of leading an Official GWR Guild.
Guild Leaders are expected to collaborate rather than operate as completely independent entities.
Guild leadership must follow GWR rules, standards and overall direction.
The Guild Leader and Officers are expected to remain reasonably active.
Leadership must communicate if circumstances change.
Leadership positions may be reviewed if someone becomes inactive or is no longer suitable for the position.
If a Guild Leader steps down or is replaced, in-game leadership is expected to be transferred to the successor appointed through the GWR leadership process.
